name: tendsto_nhdsWithin_congr
result.signature:
{f g : α → β} {s : Set α} {a : α} {l : Filter β} (hfg : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = g x) (hf : Tendsto f (𝓝[s] a) l) :
  Tendsto g (𝓝[s] a) l
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {f g : α → β} {s : Set α} {a : α} {l : Filter β},
  (∀ x ∈ s, f x = g x) → Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a s) l → Filter.Tendsto g (nhdsWithin a s) l
result.informal_name: Congruence of Limits Within a Set for Equal Functions
result.informal_description: If two functions $f$ and $g$ agree on a set $s$ containing $a$, and $f$ converges to a filter $l$ along the neighborhood filter of $a$ within $s$, then $g$ also converges to $l$ along the same filter. Formally, if $\forall x \in s, f(x) = g(x)$ and $\lim_{x \to \mathcal{N}(a) \cap s} f(x) = l$, then $\lim_{x \to \mathcal{N}(a) \cap s} g(x) = l$.

EventuallyEq
derivWithin_eq_of_nhds
result.signature: (hs : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f) : derivWithin f₁ s x = derivWithin f s x
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f f₁ : 𝕜 → F} {x : 𝕜} {s : Set 𝕜},
  f₁ =ᶠ[nhds x] f → derivWithin f₁ s x = derivWithin f s x
result.informal_name: Derivatives Within a Set Are Equal If Functions Agree on a Neighborhood
result.informal_description: If two functions $ f_1 $ and $ f $ are equal in a neighborhood of $ x $, then their derivatives within the set $ s $ at $ x $ are equal.

name: continuousAt_congr
result.signature: {g : X → Y} (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g) : ContinuousAt f x ↔ ContinuousAt g x
result.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} {x : X}
  {g : X → Y}, f =ᶠ[nhds x] g → (ContinuousAt f x ↔ ContinuousAt g x)
result.value: := by simp only [ContinuousAt, tendsto_congr' h, h.eq_of_nhds]
result.informal_name: Continuity at a Point is Preserved by Neighborhood Agreement
result.informal_description: If two functions $ f $ and $ g $ are equal on a neighborhood of $ x $, then $ f $ is continuous at $ x $ if and only if $ g $ is continuous at $ x $.

name: MDifferentiableAt
congr_of_eventuallyEq
result.signature: (h : MDifferentiableAt I I' f x) (hL : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f) : MDifferentiableAt I I' f₁ x
result.informal_name: Differentiability Congruence for Locally Equal Functions on Manifolds with Corners
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ is differentiable at a point $ x $ on a manifold with corners, and another function $ f_1 $ agrees with $ f $ on a neighborhood of $ x $, then $ f_1 $ is also differentiable at $ x $ with respect to the same model with corners and target differentiability structure.

name: DifferentiableAt
congr_of_eventuallyEq
result.signature: (h : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hL : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f) : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f₁ x
result.informal_description: If $ f $ is differentiable at $ x $ and $ f_1 $ is eventually equal to $ f $ in the neighborhood of $ x $, then $ f_1 $ is also differentiable at $ x $.

name: ContMDiffAt
congr_of_eventuallyEq
result.signature: (h : ContMDiffAt I I' n f x) (h₁ : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f) : ContMDiffAt I I' n f₁ x
result.informal_name: C^n Differentiability is Preserved under Eventual Equality in a Neighborhood
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ is $ C^n $-differentiable at a point $ x $ with respect to charts $ I $ and $ I' $, and another function $ f_1 $ agrees with $ f $ on some neighborhood of $ x $, then $ f_1 $ is also $ C^n $-differentiable at $ x $ with respect to the same charts $ I $ and $ I' $.
